ruleDefinitions.name: Sensitive File Recovery From Backup Via Wbadmin.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the dump of highly sensitive files such as "NTDS.DIT" and "SECURITY" hive.
Attackers can leverage the "wbadmin" utility in order to dump sensitive files that might contain credential or sensitive information.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wbadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WBADMIN\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ recovery.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*recoveryTarget.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*itemtype\\:File.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\SAM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\SECURITY.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\SYSTEM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\NTDS\\\\NTDS\\\.dit.*"))))
